sloka: महाकपालः स्थूलाक्षः प्रमाथी च महाबलः ।महाकपालो विपुलम् शूलम् उद्यम्य राक्षसः ॥३-२६-१८॥
transliteration: mahākapālaḥ sthūlākṣaḥ pramāthī ca mahābalaḥ ।mahākapālo vipulam śūlam udyamya rākṣasaḥ ॥3-26-18॥

translations.english: Mahakapala had a huge spear, Sthulaksha, a sharpedged spear and Pramathi, a battleaxe.
